facts.text: The hotel is in downtown Reykjavik by the Old Harbor port.
facts.excerpt: Located in the historical, scenic heart of downtown Reykjavik by Old Harbor port

facts.text: The hotel is steps from Laugavegur Street and the Harpa Concert and Conference Center.
facts.excerpt: just steps away from the Laugavegur Street, the city’s vibrant shopping district, and the Harpa Concert and Conference Center

facts.text: The hotel is a 45-minute car ride from the airport.
facts.excerpt: the hotel is a 45-minute car ride from the airport

facts.text: Rooms and suites have views of the harbor, Mt. Esja and the Snæfellsjökull glacier.
facts.excerpt: offer spectacular views of the harbor, Mt. Esja and the legendary Snæfellsjökull glacier

facts.text: Room decor uses ash wood and pale gray oak, copper details, faux fur rugs, and artwork and accessories from local craftsmen.
facts.excerpt: Warm palettes of ash wood and pale gray oak are embellished with bespoke furniture, copper details, faux fur rugs, and artwork and accessories from local craftsmen.

facts.text: Bathrooms have enclosed rainfall showers and Le Labo toiletries.
facts.excerpt: enclosed rainfall showers and standard custom Le Labo toiletries

facts.text: Some rooms have their own outdoor terraces.
facts.excerpt: Some rooms have their own outdoor terraces

facts.text: Room types include Connecting Family Rooms.
TIDES, the signature restaurant, serves Icelandic seafood along with locally sourced meats and ingredients.
facts.excerpt: celebrating the best seafood from the pristine waters of Iceland along with locally sourced meats and ingredients

facts.text: THE ROOF is on the 7th floor with panoramic mountain and ocean views and a wrap-around seasonal outdoor terrace.
facts.excerpt: THE ROOF is located on the hotel’s 7th floor and offers panoramic mountain and ocean views.

facts.text: TÖLT is a cozy bar named after the fourth gait of Icelandic horses, featuring local Icelandic spirits.
facts.excerpt: Named after the unique fourth gait Icelandic horses are best known for, TÖLT is a cozy bar, designed as a hidden sanctuary.

facts.text: The Lobby Bar has an open-flame fireplace and serves locally produced craft beers and cocktails with an Icelandic twist.
facts.excerpt: featuring an open-flame fireplace, serving locally produced craft beers, specialty cocktails with an Icelandic twist

facts.text: Tides Cafe serves locally roasted coffee, pastries and sandwiches.
facts.excerpt: serves locally roasted coffee, brewed in-house

facts.text: The EDITION Spa has a hammam, steam room and sauna.
facts.excerpt: including a hammam, steam room, and sauna

facts.text: Spa access is for guests aged 18 and over, with an access fee.
facts.excerpt: Spa access is available to guests aged 18 and over, with an access fee

facts.text: The gym is on the lower-ground floor, open 24 hours, with Matrix equipment.
facts.excerpt: Located on the lower-ground floor, the 24-hour Gym at The Reykjavik EDITION

facts.text: The Blue Lagoon is within driving distance.
facts.excerpt: the renowned Blue Lagoon within driving distance

facts.text: The Northern Lights are visible in the city during the winter solstice.
facts.excerpt: the Northern Lights visible in the city during the winter solstice
